Experience with API integration and system interoperability. Familiarity with version control tools such as Git . Understanding of Agile/Scrum development methodologies. Knowledge of containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes . Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and Dev Ops practices. Experience working with messaging frameworks such as Kafka or Rabbit MQ .

title: Associate Program Manager
jobDescription:
e Clerx is looking to hire an experienced professional with over 12 years of experience. As part of the Voice process team, your role will specifically focus on troubleshooting related processes. The ideal candidate will serve customers by planning and implementing strategies and operations; improving systems and processes; managing staff. Candidate will determine call center operational strategies by conducting needs assessments, performance reviews, capacity planning, and cost/benefit analyses; identifying and evaluating state-of-the-art technologies; defining user requirements; establishing technical specifications, and production, productivity, quality, and customer-service standards; contributing information and analysis to organizational strategic plans and reviews. The leader must demonstrate an ability to anticipate, understand, and act on evolving customer needs, both stated and unstated. Through this, candidate must create a customer-centric organization and use innovative thinking frameworks to foster value-added relations. With the right balance of bold initiatives, continuous improvement and governance, the leader must adhere to the delivery standards set by the client and e Clerx by leveraging the knowledge of market drivers and competition to effectively anticipate trends and opportunities. In addition, the leader must demonstrate a capacity to transform, align, and energize organization resources, and take appropriate risks to lead the organization in a new direction. As a leader, the candidate must build engaged and high-impact direct, virtual and cross-functional teams, and take the lead towards raising the performance bar, build capability and bring out the best in their teams. By collaborating and forging partnerships both within and outside the functional area, the leader must work towards a shared vision and achieve positive business outcomes. Candidate must also possess an understanding of the repair process in Telecom and Cable industry, with an ability to analyze information and evaluate results to choose best solutions and solve problems. Customer Operations Associate Program Manager Responsibilities Maintains and improves operations by monitoring system performance; identifying and resolving problems; preparing and completing action plans; completing system audits and analyses; managing system and process improvement and quality assurance programs; installing upgrades Accomplish human resource objectives by recruiting, selecting, orienting, training, assigning, coaching, counselling, and disciplining employees; administering scheduling systems; communicating job expectations; planning, monitoring, appraising, and reviewing job contributions; planning and reviewing compensation actions; enforcing policies and procedures Prepares performance reports by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing data and trends Meets financial objectives by estimating requirements; preparing an annual budget; scheduling expenditures; analyzing variances; initiating corrective actions. Maintains professional and technical knowledge by tracking emerging trends in BPO operations management; attending educational workshops; reviewing professional publications; establishing personal networks; benchmarking state-of-the-art practices; participating in professional societies. Accomplishes organization goals by accepting ownership for accomplishing new and different requests; exploring opportunities to add value to job accomplishments. Ensure Critical Performance Metrics are met consistently Lead client/vendor reviews/calibrations Revert to client/vendor queries on routine issues Provide innovative ideas to optimize internal metrics & ensure critical matrices are met timely Manage multiple teams Perform audits and quality checks on Team Leads & Floor Supports Provide feedback to the Team Leads & Floor Supports periodically on their performance Ensure cross skilling and periodic process re-verification to ensure resource pool Perform Training Need Identification for teams Perform Bottom Quartile Management Ensure directives from senior leadership are percolated and acted upon Hold periodic meetings, discuss task delegation and review issues Conduct team huddles and meetings to discuss operational updates Build team spirit through group sessions, activities, and projects Focus on retention of staff through career mapping & guiding team members Advocate and follow organizational policies and procedures Adhere to the information security requirements Ensure all client deliverables met within timelines Ensure productivity/quality enhancement and process meet all metrics Remediation of any major incident Manage client MBR/QBR deck, client calls and reviews Minimum Qualifications Overall experience of 10+ years and should be a graduate or post graduate in any specialization Preferred Qualifications
- Graduation in Computer Science, Computer Applications or related subjects

title: Senior Analyst
jobDescription:
Job Description: BPO MIS Sr.Analyst (SQL & VBA Must). Minimum 6 Months Experience Position: BPO MIS Sr. Analyst, Location: Chandigarh, Company: e Clerx Services Limited, Employment Type: Full-time About the

ROLE:
As a BPO MIS Sr.Analyst, you will be responsible for managing and analyzing data to ensure the effective operation of our Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) services. Your primary focus will be on developing, maintaining, and optimizing Management Information Systems (MIS) to support decision-making processes and enhance operational efficiency. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Data Management: Collect, organize, and analyze large volumes of data from various sources to generate meaningful insights and reports. MIS Development: Design, develop, and maintain MIS reports and dashboards to monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and operational metrics. Data Analysis: Perform in-depth analysis of operational data to identify trends, patterns, and areas for improvement. Reporting: Generate and distribute daily, weekly, and monthly reports to relevant stakeholders, ensuring accuracy and timeliness. Process Improvement: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and implement process improvements based on data analysis findings. Database Management: Manage and maintain databases, ensuring data integrity, security, and availability. Support: Provide support to the operations team by addressing data-related queries and troubleshooting MIS-related issues. Training: Train and support end-users on MIS tools and reporting systems.

QUALIFICATIONS:

EDUCATION:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field. Experience: Proven experience as an MIS Sr.Analyst or in a similar role, preferably within the BPO industry. Experience with data analysis, reporting, and database management. Technical Skills: Proficiency in MS Office Suite (Excel, Access, Power Point) and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI). Knowledge of SQL and database management systems. Familiarity with data analytics tools and programming languages (e.g., Python, R) is a plus. Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex data sets. Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present data insights clearly and concisely. Attention to Detail: High level of accuracy and attention to detail in data analysis and reporting. Organizational Skills: Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines. What We Offer: Competitive salary and benefits package. Opportunities for professional growth and development. A collaborative and dynamic work environment. The chance to make a significant impact on the efficiency and success of our BPO operations. jobDescription:
The candidate must possess in-depth functional knowledge of HR processes and apply it to operational scenarios to provide effective solutions. It is vital to be open-minded towards inputs and views from team members and to effectively lead, control, and motivate groups towards company’s vision. jobDescription:
Job Description: As a Customer Care Executive for the Inbound US Voice Process with a focus on Sales and Upselling, you will be responsible for delivering outstanding customer service to customers in the United States and also selling products and services to increase revenue. You will be the first point of contact for customers who call in with inquiries, and your primary goal will be to ensure that their needs are addressed, their questions are answered, and their interest in purchasing products and services is captured. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Answering incoming calls from customers in a professional and courteous manner. Listening actively to customers and asking probing questions to fully understand their needs and concerns. Providing accurate and timely information to customers about products and services, pricing, and promotions, while actively seeking opportunities to upsell. Handling customer objections and concerns with empathy and professionalism, and working to address them to close the sale. Documenting all customer interactions and details of inquiries, issues, and sales in the company's CRM system. Meeting or exceeding individual and team sales targets. Maintaining a high level of knowledge about the company's products and services, as well as industry trends and best practices. Requirements: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. Previous experience in a customer service and sales role, preferably in a call center environment. Ability to multitask, prioritize, and manage time effectively. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to think on your feet. Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment. Flexibility to work in rotational shifts, including evenings, weekends, and holidays. Familiarity with basic computer skills and knowledge of CRM systems.

EDUCATION:
Bachelor's degree in any field is preferred. If you are a people-person with a passion for delivering outstanding customer service and have the necessary skills and experience to drive sales and upselling, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

title: Analyst
jobDescription:
Job Description: As a Customer Care Executive for the Inbound US Voice Process with a focus on Sales and Upselling, you will be responsible for delivering outstanding customer service to customers in the United States and also selling products and services to increase revenue. You will be the first point of contact for customers who call in with inquiries, and your primary goal will be to ensure that their needs are addressed, their questions are answered, and their interest in purchasing products and services is captured. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Answering incoming calls from customers in a professional and courteous manner. Listening actively to customers and asking probing questions to fully understand their needs and concerns. Providing accurate and timely information to customers about products and services, pricing, and promotions, while actively seeking opportunities to upsell. Handling customer objections and concerns with empathy and professionalism, and working to address them to close the sale. Documenting all customer interactions and details of inquiries, issues, and sales in the company's CRM system. Meeting or exceeding individual and team sales targets. Maintaining a high level of knowledge about the company's products and services, as well as industry trends and best practices. Requirements: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. Previous experience in a customer service and sales role, preferably in a call center environment. Ability to multitask, prioritize, and manage time effectively. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to think on your feet. Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment. Flexibility to work in rotational shifts, including evenings, weekends, and holidays. Familiarity with basic computer skills and knowledge of CRM systems.

EDUCATION:
Bachelor's degree in any field is preferred. If you are a people-person with a passion for delivering outstanding customer service and have the necessary skills and experience to drive sales and upselling, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

title: Analyst
jobDescription:
Job Description: As a Customer Care Executive for the Inbound US Voice Process with a focus on Sales and Upselling, you will be responsible for delivering outstanding customer service to customers in the United States and also selling products and services to increase revenue. You will be the first point of contact for customers who call in with inquiries, and your primary goal will be to ensure that their needs are addressed, their questions are answered, and their interest in purchasing products and services is captured. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Answering incoming calls from customers in a professional and courteous manner. Listening actively to customers and asking probing questions to fully understand their needs and concerns. Providing accurate and timely information to customers about products and services, pricing, and promotions, while actively seeking opportunities to upsell. Handling customer objections and concerns with empathy and professionalism, and working to address them to close the sale. Documenting all customer interactions and details of inquiries, issues, and sales in the company's CRM system. Meeting or exceeding individual and team sales targets. Maintaining a high level of knowledge about the company's products and services, as well as industry trends and best practices. Requirements: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. Previous experience in a customer service and sales role, preferably in a call center environment. Ability to multitask, prioritize, and manage time effectively. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to think on your feet. Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment. Flexibility to work in rotational shifts, including evenings, weekends, and holidays. Familiarity with basic computer skills and knowledge of CRM systems.

EDUCATION:
Bachelor's degree in any field is preferred. If you are a people-person with a passion for delivering outstanding customer service and have the necessary skills and experience to drive sales and upselling, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

title: Senior Process Manager
jobDescription:
At e Clerx, we pride ourselves on providing exceptional customer service. Our inbound voice contact center is the heart of our customer interactions, and we are looking for a Senior Manager to lead our dedicated team. If you have a passion for customer satisfaction, team leadership, and operational excellence, we want you on our team. Position Summary: The Senior Manager, Inbound Voice Contact Center, will oversee the daily operations of our inbound contact center. This role requires a dynamic leader who can manage and motivate a team of supervisors and agents, ensure customer satisfaction, and drive continuous improvement in service delivery. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in contact center management, excellent communication skills, and a strategic mindset. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Leadership & Team Management: Lead, mentor, and develop a team of supervisors and contact center agents to ensure high performance. Foster a positive and inclusive work environment that encourages teamwork and continuous improvement. Operational Management: Oversee the daily operations of the inbound contact center to ensure efficient and effective service delivery. Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and implement strategies to achieve or exceed targets. Develop and implement policies and procedures to improve operational efficiency and customer satisfaction. Customer Experience: Ensure that the highest level of customer service is provided in every interaction. Handle escalated customer issues and complaints, ensuring prompt and satisfactory resolution. Analyze customer feedback and trends to identify areas for improvement. Strategic Planning & Execution: Develop and execute strategic plans to enhance contact center operations and achieve business objectives. Collaborate with senior leadership to align contact center goals with overall company strategy. Stay updated on industry trends and best practices to drive innovation and improvements. Performance Management: Conduct regular performance reviews and provide feedback to supervisors and agents. Identify training needs and coordinate with the training department to ensure staff development. Implement and manage incentive programs to motivate and reward high performance. Reporting & Analysis: Prepare and present regular reports on contact center performance, including call volume, response times, and customer satisfaction. Use data and analytics to identify trends, make informed decisions, and drive continuous improvement.

QUALIFICATIONS:
Bachelor's degree in any field. Minimum of 7 years of experience in contact center management Proven track record of leading and managing large teams in a high-volume contact center environment. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make data-driven decisions. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact effectively with all levels of the organization. Proficient in contact center software and technologies. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

jobDescription:
Role Overview The Adobe Workfront Solutions Consultant will be a crucial subject matter expert, responsible for the end-to-end implementation, configuration, and integration of the Adobe Workfront platform for our clients/internal stakeholders. This role requires a strong blend of technical Workfront expertise, business process analysis, and proven Program Management skills to drive large-scale Work Management and Digital Transformation initiatives. Key Responsibilities
1. Implementation and Configuration (Expertise) Lead Implementations: Lead the full lifecycle of Adobe Workfront implementations, from requirements gathering and blueprinting to deployment and post-launch support. Solution Design: Translate complex business requirements (workflows, resource management, budgeting) into optimized technical solutions within Workfront, utilizing custom forms, custom fields, calculated data, and views. Configuration: Expertly configure Workfront objects including Projects, Programs, Portfolios, Tasks, User Roles, Access Levels, Request Queues, and Approval Workflows. Reporting: Design and build advanced dashboards and reports (including Text Mode) to provide real-time visibility into project health, resource utilization, and portfolio performance for executive stakeholders.
2. Integration and Automation Workfront Fusion:Mandatory experience with Adobe Workfront Fusion (formerly Fusion/Workfront Scenario Builder) to design, develop, and deploy complex automation scenarios. System Integration: Oversee and execute integration projects between Workfront and other core business systems (e.g., Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), Jira, Salesforce, DAM systems, ERP/HCM) using Fusion, APIs, or native connectors. Data Migration: Manage data migration strategies from legacy systems into Workfront, ensuring data integrity and structure alignment.
3. Program Management and Consulting Strategic Alignment: Work closely with leadership to align Workfront programs with overarching business goals, ensuring the platform supports the organization's long-term strategic direction (e.g., Marketing Transformation, Product Development). Governance: Define and enforce platform governance, best practices, change management processes, and user adoption strategies across the organization. Stakeholder Management: Serve as a primary point of contact for project sponsors, managing expectations, communicating progress, and mitigating risks across multiple concurrent Workfront projects/programs. Training & Support: Develop and deliver engaging training sessions, documentation, and office hours to promote platform adoption and maximize user proficiency. Required Skills & Qualifications Experience: Minimum 3+ years of hands-on experience in implementing, configuring, and administering Adobe Workfront. Workfront Expertise: Proven, in-depth knowledge of Workfront features, data model, and API capabilities. Integration Proficiency: Must have hands-on experience with Adobe Workfront Fusion (or similar IPaa S tools like Dell Boomi/Informatica) for complex integrations and workflow automation. Workfront Administration: Create and manage Workfront projects, templates, reports, and dashboards Ensure consistent use of Workfront across teams, promoting best practices and user adoption Program/Project Management: Demonstrated experience managing cross-functional programs or multiple related projects simultaneously. Certifications (Preferred): Active Adobe Workfront Certified System Administrator or Workfront Certified Consultant is highly desirable. Soft Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication, presentation, and client-facing consulting skills.

EDUCATION:
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.

jobDescription:
Job Description The candidate will be responsible for end-to-end execution of credit card campaign setup, configuration, and deployment within enterprise offer management systems. This role ensures operational excellence through rigorous quality controls, compliance validation, and data integrity oversight across all stages of the offer lifecycle—from activation through expiration. The position requires strong technical acumen, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, product, and compliance stakeholders to deliver error-free, compliant credit card offers to market. Offer Configuration & Campaign Execution Manage end-to-end import processes for enterprise offer management platforms by reviewing, validating, and executing import templates containing APR updates, Beacon Rate adjustments, Prime Rate changes, ETL logic, rolling criteria, offer expiration dates, and respond-by parameters. Execute precise system updates to activate, extend, or expire credit card campaigns in alignment with approved stakeholder requirements and regulatory timelines. Translate business requirements into technical configurations, ensuring seamless handoff from strategy to live execution. Quality Assurance & Data Validation Perform comprehensive post-import validation by extracting and analyzing UMM reports from Business Intelligence systems Conduct systematic reconciliation of Business Intelligence systems against approved import templates to ensure 100% data accuracy and configuration integrity. Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve discrepancies between system inputs and reporting outputs, escalating critical issues as needed. Compliance & Governance Maintain audit-ready documentation and ensure all offer configurations meet compliance, regulatory, and risk management standards. Uphold data governance protocols by maintaining the Offer Repository as the centralized, authoritative source of truth for all active and planned credit card campaigns. Provide visibility and traceability across campaign lifecycles to support internal audits and stakeholder inquiries. Stakeholder Collaboration & Communication Partner with business, marketing, and compliance teams to clarify requirements, validate change requests, and ensure alignment on campaign objectives. Develop Campaign Approval Documents (CADs) by translating approved campaign specifications into presentation-ready materials for executive and operational audiences. Capture, annotate, and document landing page specifications and visual updates with structured markup to drive execution clarity and reduce rework. Required Technical Skills Offer Management Platforms : Strong working knowledge of ITSS or equivalent campaign execution and offer management systems. Business Intelligence & Reporting : Proven experience extracting, validating, and reconciling data from Cognos or similar BI/reporting platforms. Data Validation & Integrity : Ability to interpret and validate complex financial parameters including APRs, Beacon Rates, Prime Rates, ETL logic, rolling eligibility criteria, and expiration rules. Analytical Rigor : High attention to data accuracy, validation controls, discrepancy analysis, and root-cause investigation across integrated systems. Campaign Lifecycle Management : Familiarity with offer repositories, end-to-end campaign workflows, and compliance-driven change management processes. Process Discipline : Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent campaigns with precision, timeliness, and audit readiness. Required MS Office & Productivity Skills Microsoft Excel: Advanced proficiency in data validation, reconciliation, and reporting using formulas, filters, pivot tables, and conditional formatting. Microsoft Power Point: Strong capability in CAD creation, campaign documentation, and executive-level stakeholder presentations. Microsoft Outlook: Professional communication skills for stakeholder coordination, follow-ups, and cross-functional collaboration. Microsoft Word: Working knowledge for process documentation, operational SOPs, and audit-ready records management. Qualifications Experience: 5–7 years in credit card operations, digital campaign management, or offer configuration within financial services.

EDUCATION:
Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Information Systems, or related field preferred. Competencies: Strong project management skills, detail orientation, stakeholder management, and ability to thrive in a fast-paced, compliance-driven environment.

jobDescription: As a Senior Analyst/APM, you will play a crucial role in designing and implementing cutting-edge AI solutions. Your primary focus will be on developing multi-agent systems using Large Language Models (LLMs) and integrating various APIs and tools. You will be responsible for optimizing performance through reinforcement learning and memory-driven architectures, ensuring our AI agents can reason, make decisions, and automate tasks effectively. Design and Develop AI Agents: Build intelligent, autonomous agents leveraging LLMs, memory frameworks, and multi-agent coordination systems (e.g., Lang Chain, Crew AI, Auto Gen). Integrate APIs and Tools: Connect agents with third-party APIs, knowledge bases, and internal systems to enable dynamic data access and real-time task execution. Optimize Agent Performance: Apply reinforcement learning, context management, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) techniques to enhance reasoning and accuracy. Develop End-to-End Pipelines: Create scalable, production-ready pipelines for AI agent deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. Collaborate with Cross-Functional Teams: Partner with product managers, ML engineers, and domain experts to translate business use cases into functional agentic systems e Clerx Services Ltd is seeking a Senior Analyst/APM to join our Technology Services team. The role involves developing innovative Agentic AI solutions, with a focus on multi-agent systems and autonomous agents. We are looking for a skilled developer to lead and enhance our AI capabilities.

Ability to multitask, prioritize, and manage time effectively. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to think on your feet. Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment. Flexibility to work in rotational shifts, including evenings, weekends, and holidays. Familiarity with basic computer skills and knowledge of CRM systems.

jobDescription: Role Overview: We are looking for a highly technical Senior Social Media Ads Expert with 5+ years of experience to scale our global B2C presence. You will lead performance-driven campaigns across Meta (Facebook/Instagram), Tik Tok, Snapchat, and other emerging social platforms. You will be responsible for the full lifecycle of performance campaigns—from advanced technical setup, optimization, A/B testing & reporting. Key Responsibilities Design and execute high-budget campaigns on Meta Ads Manager, Tik Tok Ads Manager, and Snapchat Ads. Manage "Always-On" and seasonal B2C campaigns across North America, LATAM, EMEA, and APAC, ensuring local relevance in over 12 currencies. Drive measurable growth for App Installs, Subscriptions, and Web Conversions, optimizing for post-install events and Lifetime Value (LTV). Expertly deploy Meta Advantage+ and Tik Tok Smart Performance Campaigns (SPC), knowing exactly when to use "Black Box" automation versus manual precision targeting. Ensure 100% data accuracy by managing the Meta Conversions API (CAPI), Tik Tok Pixel/Events API, and Snapchat Pixel via GTM. Proactively identify and fix tracking "blackouts," attribution shifts, or sudden spikes in CPA across global accounts. Navigate i OS 14+ and Android privacy changes using SKAd Network / Ad Attribution Kit and incrementality testing to prove true channel lift. Collaborate with design teams to brief "Native-first" content (UGC, Reels, Tik Tok trends) based on hard performance data. Run rigorous A/B and Multivariate tests on hooks, CTAs, and visual formats, moving beyond vanity metrics to focus on conversion volume. Qualifications Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience in paid social for global B2C brands. Platform Expertise: * Expert proficiency in Meta, Tik Tok, and Snapchat (Certifications preferred). Experience with Pinterest or X (Twitter) Ads is a plus. Strong understanding of GTM, GA4, and mobile measurement partners (MMP) like Apps Flyer or Adjust. Ability to work with basic Python/Java Script for ad scripts or API connectors. Experience managing campaigns across different time zones, currencies, and languages.

title: Associate Process Manager
jobDescription: General Position Requirements / Scope We are looking for an experienced Campaign Operations Analyst to join our Lifecycle Marketing team. You bring 3–5 years of hands-on campaign execution experience and are equally comfortable configuring journeys in Adobe Journey Optimizer as you are writing SQL to validate the data underneath them. You operate independently, take full ownership of your campaigns from build through deployment, and hold yourself to a high bar for data accuracy and operational quality. This is a technical, execution-focused role on a team that moves fast and values precision. Campaign Build & Execution Independently own the full lifecycle of multi-channel campaign builds in Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO) — including journey design, message authoring, audience assignment, suppression logic, scheduling, and deployment across email, push, SMS, and in-app channels. Configure and manage audience segments in Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) using the segment builder, applying complex behavioral, event-based, demographic, and product-usage criteria to meet campaign targeting requirements. Execute rigorous pre-send QA covering content accuracy, link validation, dynamic personalization, audience sizing, suppression integrity, frequency cap compliance, and regulatory opt-out checks. Manage a concurrent portfolio of campaigns across multiple marketing programs, consistently meeting deadlines without compromising quality. Monitor live journeys and scheduled sends for performance and execution health, identifying and resolving issues in real time. Collaborate with Marketing strategists and Creative teams to translate campaign briefs into technically precise execution plans, raising data or platform feasibility concerns early. SQL & Data Validation Write proficient, independent SQL against Big Query, Snowflake, or equivalent cloud data warehouses to validate audience logic, verify segment membership, confirm suppression accuracy, and size eligibility pools ahead of every campaign. Use SQL to diagnose and resolve data discrepancies — including mismatched counts between AEP segments and source tables, unexpected audience fluctuations, profile attribute gaps, and ingestion anomalies. Build and maintain a library of reusable SQL scripts for recurring campaign validation tasks: deduplication checks, holdout group verification, frequency analysis, and eligibility audits. Conduct post-campaign data pulls to support performance reporting, holdout measurement, deliverability analysis, and data reconciliation between AJO send logs and source systems. Partner with Data Engineering to surface upstream data quality issues with query-backed evidence, clearly articulating the business impact on campaign audiences. Validate AEP dataset ingestion completeness and profile attribute accuracy using SQL, flagging pipeline gaps that could affect targeting before they reach production. Platform Operations & Governance Apply and enforce campaign governance standards across all builds: naming conventions, folder organization, tagging taxonomies, consent and compliance controls, and change management procedures. Monitor AEP data ingestion pipelines and AJO journey execution health, proactively identifying anomalies that could degrade campaign performance or data quality. Contribute to platform configuration work including A/B test setup, template management, suppression list maintenance, and segment catalog hygiene. Assist in evaluating new AJO and AEP platform capabilities, providing operational perspective on feasibility and implementation requirements. Cross-functional Collaboration Act as the primary liaison between Marketing, Marketing Technology, and Data Engineering, on campaign operations topics. Required 3–5 years of hands-on experience in campaign operations, marketing technology , or a closely related technical role. Proficient, production-level SQL skills — you independently write complex queries involving JOINs, CTEs, window functions, aggregations, and subqueries to solve real data problems without assistance or templates. Proven hands-on experience with Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO) — you have independently built, QA'd, and deployed journeys across multiple channels in a professional environment. Solid working knowledge of Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) — including segment builder, XDM schema structure, profile attributes, dataset management, and identity resolution concepts. Direct experience querying cloud data warehouses such as Big Query, Snowflake, or Databricks as part of regular campaign operations work. Strong QA instincts and a systematic approach to verifying data accuracy before every send. Ability to manage a concurrent workload of campaigns across multiple priorities with minimal supervision. Clear, confident communicator — able to present data findings, raise platform concerns, and explain technical details to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Preferred Deep familiarity with AEP data ops: ADLS ingestion pipelines, AJO journey execution monitoring, segment evaluation jobs, and profile snapshot audits. Experience with additional Adobe Experience Cloud tools such as Adobe Analytics or Adobe Target. Working knowledge of HTML/CSS for email template QA, rendering troubleshooting, and minor template edits. Solid understanding of email deliverability principles and marketing compliance requirements (CAN-SPAM, GDPR, CCPA). Experience with BI or analytics tools such as Looker, Tableau, or similar platforms. Familiarity with dbt or data modeling concepts as they relate to marketing audience tables. Experience working in agile environments with sprint-based delivery and ticket-driven workflows. Data Ops

ROLE:
As a BPO MIS Analyst, you will be responsible for managing and analyzing data to ensure the effective operation of our Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) services. Your primary focus will be on developing, maintaining, and optimizing Management Information Systems (MIS) to support decision-making processes and enhance operational efficiency. Key

jobDescription:
Job Description: Outbound Voice – Analyst We are seeking motivated individuals to join our Outbound Voice Team as Technical Support Agents. In this role, you will be responsible for making outbound calls to customers who have reported technical issues with our products or services. Your primary objective will be to troubleshoot the reported problems and provide effective solutions to resolve them. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Make outbound calls to customers to address reported technical issues. Listen actively to customers' concerns and accurately diagnose the root cause of the problem. Provide clear and concise instructions to customers on troubleshooting steps. Guide customers through troubleshooting processes, ensuring they understand each step. Utilize various tools and resources to identify and resolve technical issues efficiently. Document all interactions and resolutions accurately in the customer database. Escalate unresolved issues to appropriate internal/external teams for further investigation. Follow up to ensure that their technical issues have been fully resolved and they are satisfied with the outcome. Adhere to company policies and procedures at all times. Requirements: Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written. Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail. Ability to remain calm and patient when dealing with frustrated customers. Technical aptitude and ability to quickly learn and understand new technologies. Previous experience in a technical support or customer service role is preferred. Familiarity with CRM software and call center technology is a plus. High school diploma or equivalent; additional technical certifications are a bonus.
